setup.description: Sets up the ticket creation panel in a specified channel.
setup.panelChannel: The channel where the ticket panel will be sent.
setup.panelMessage: The main message/description for the ticket panel.
setup.buttonLabel: The label for the ticket creation button (default: Open ticket)
setup.category: The category where new tickets will be created (optional).
setup.closedCategory: The category where closed tickets will be moved (optional).
setup.staffRole: The role that can access tickets (optional).
setup.maxTickets: Maximum number of tickets a user can create (default: 3)
setup.dmOnClose: Send closure notice by DM; transcript and feedback DMs are separate (default: true)
